_comment: Minnesota OSA City/County Finances Report — per-FY raw-data XLSX URL manifest. Slugs scraped verbatim from the OSA cities + counties landing pages on 2026-06-27 (the /media/<slug>/ segment is opaque and differs per file — never guessed). Every URL verified HTTP 200 (ranged GET). City actuals = cired_<YY>_data.xlsx, continuous XLSX FY2012–FY2023 (pre-2012 = .zip, out of scope). County actuals diverge: cored_<YY>_data.xlsx for FY2013–FY2017, then renamed county_<YY>_data.xlsx for FY2019–FY2021 (note county_21 is 'county_21_-data.xlsx'). County data LAGS cities — latest county = FY2021; FY2018/FY2022/FY2023 have no county data XLSX (reports only); FY2006–FY2011 county files are legacy .xls (NOT exceljs-readable, out of scope). Source of record for v2.9 — see auto-memory reference_minnesota_osa_finances_report.
source: Minnesota Office of the State Auditor City/County Finances Report

notes.pre_xlsx: City FY2002–2003 = CSV, FY2004–2011 = ZIP; County FY2006–2011 = legacy .xls (binary, NOT exceljs-readable). All pre-XLSX history is out of scope for v2.9 (XLSX-era only).
notes.county_naming_shift: County file naming changed from cored_<YY>_data.xlsx (FY2013–2017) to county_<YY>_data.xlsx (FY2019–2021). county_21 url filename is 'county_21_-data.xlsx' (extra dash).
notes.county_gaps: No county data XLSX for FY2012, FY2018, FY2022, FY2023 (FY2022/2023 publish reports only). County coverage = FY2013–2017 + FY2019–2021.
notes.county_layout_divergence: County Governmental Funds sheet has NO GAAPInd and NO ParentEntityName columns, shifted column positions, extra WheelageTax/Current Expend 1/Total Capital Outaly1 columns, and label typos ('Conservation ofNatural') vs the city file. Loader uses label-normalized matching + tolerates absent identity columns. See 89-PROOF.md / SUMMARY for the full divergence table (D-08).
